title: Two sections of a line bundle glued from reciprocal functions
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $U,V$ opens covering $X$, and $f\in\mathcal O_X(U)$, $g\in\mathcal O_X(V)$ such that their restrictions to $U\cap V$ multiply to $1$ and $D(g)=U\cap V$ (the basic open where the germ of $g$ is a unit). There exist an invertible module $L$ [def-sc-invertible-module] and two compatible global sections $s,t$ [def-weil-pbc-generating-sections] such that $X_s=U$ and $V\subseteq X_t$, with nonvanishing loci as in [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. No integral, separated, Noetherian, dimension, affine, or finiteness hypotheses are required.

source.place: Varieties Lemma 09NB (varieties-lemma-find-globally-generated), proof, cocycle, two sections, and locus calculation

proof.text: Index the two opens by Bool. On U intersect V form the unit with value the restriction of g and inverse the restriction of f, using fg=1 and commutativity. Set the same-index transitions to 1 and the reversed transition to the transported inverse unit. Restriction functoriality checks both inverse identities and all eight triple-index cocycle identities. Apply the Cech transition theorem to obtain invertible L and free frames eU,eV with eU=g eV on the overlap.

The pair (eU,g eV) agrees by the frame transition; the pair (f eU,eV) agrees by restriction compatibility with scalar multiplication and fg=1. Apply Mathlib TopCat.Sheaf.existsUnique_gluing' to each Bool-indexed family, checking reversed-overlap compatibility by restriction along the intersection commutativity isomorphism. Obtain global sections sigma,tau with the specified restrictions. Define their compatible sections by restriction from the top open to each open, proving naturality by presheaf functoriality; their top evaluations equal sigma,tau.

Use the proved nonvanishing iff GeneratesAt criterion. Every point of U is a generation point for sigma because its U-restriction is the free frame eU. Conversely, if sigma generates at x, the cover puts x in U or V. In V the local coefficient criterion for g eV gives x in D(g)=U intersect V, hence x in U. This proves the exact set equality X_sigma=U. The V-restriction of tau is the free frame eV, so every point of V is a generation point and hence a nonvanishing point of tau. The argument never requires inhabited charts and includes the empty scheme.

lean.statement: theorem exists_line_bundle_sections_of_reciprocal_cover (X : Scheme.{u}) (U V : X.Opens) (f : Γ(X, U)) (g : Γ(X, V)) (hcover : U ⊔ V = ⊤) (hinv : X.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_left).op f * X.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_right).op g = 1) (hlocus : X.basicOpen g = U ⊓ V) : ∃ (L : X.Modules) (s t : L.sections), L.IsInvertible ∧ nonvanishingLocus L (s.val (Opposite.op ⊤)) = (U : Set X) ∧ (V : Set X) ⊆ nonvanishingLocus L (t.val (Opposite.op ⊤))
